extra: This update includes window sync and other nice improvements! Window sync is a way to keep your windows organized across multiple monitors. If you want a blank window, you can do so by using opt+cmd+N (for mac), ctrl+alt+N (for linux) and alt+N (for windows). Enjoy! You can read more about window sync in our documentation here
fixes: Improved startup time when restoring large sessions.
Improved rendering for background gradient rendering / mixing when using three color gradients.

fixes.description: Fixed split views resetting their layout / sizes on startup.

fixes: Fixed pinned tabs losing their icons when being unloaded or at startup.
Fixed sub-folders separating from their parent folders when restoring in some cases.
Fixed a possible memory leak with mods.
features: Updated to Firefox 147.0 and 147.0.1

Merged window syncing! Now, when you open multiple windows of Zen, they will stay in sync with each other. Changes made in one window will automatically reflect in all other open windows. (Experimental, some features such as glance still can't sync yet.)
Session restore now remembers which space each window was in.
Closing a tab will now focus the last accessed tab instead of the tab to the bottom
Tabs can now have custom icons (set via right-click context menu).
Implemented new tab drag-and-drop system, making it easier to rearrange tabs specially when multiple layers of folders are involved.
You can now collapse all pinned tabs by clicking on the space name below the essentials.
Before, only pinned tabs could be renamed; now, any tab can be renamed via right-click context menu or double-clicking the tab title.
New MacOS profiles will now have 'switch to N space' keyboard shortcuts filled by default (control+number).
Improved native menu bar integration on MacOS (and Windows/Linux if applicable), adding a 'Spaces' menu item for easier access to space-related actions.
Enabled de-cluttering preference for context menus.
WebGPU support is now enabled for devices with Apple Silicon processors on all supported macOS versions.
Improved video playback performance on systems with AMD GPUs by enabling zero-copy playback for hardware-decoded video where supported, bringing them to parity with Intel and NVIDIA GPUs.
Zen now supports the Safe Browsing V5 protocol and is migrating from Safe Browsing V4 to the local list mode of Safe Browsing V5 protocol.
Added an 'Essentials DnD Promo' card, shown when dragging a tab to the top of the sidebar if there are no essentials.

fixes: Fixed an issue with new profiles not properly migrating the session files
changes: Changed the default keyboard shortcut for a new blank window to cmd+shift+N (for mac), ctrl+shift+N (for linux/windows)

fixes: Fixed blank windows when opening Zen for the first time or new windows on some occasions.
Fixed an issue where essentials would disappear intermittently.
Fixed pinned tabs not restoring to their base URL at startup.
Other minor bug fixes and stability improvements related to window sync and its respective migration system.
features: Updated to Firefox 147.0.2
Added 'close to the most recently used tab' option to the tab management settings.

fixes.description: Fixed auto-focusing on inputs not working for popup windows, such as Bitwarden's login prompt.

fixes: Fixed not being able to drag and drop tabs between different windows if WS is disabled.
Added extra migration backup checks to prevent possible data loss during migration.
Fixed drag and dropping into split views not working as expected.
Resolved an issue where drag and dropping tabs into different windows would sometimes fail.
Other small quality of life improvements and bug fixes.

extra: This update includes a new setting to allow users who didn't like the window sync feature but still want to sync their pinned tabs across windows in a workspace to do so. Make sure window sync is enabled in about:config for this feature to work.
fixes: Fixed an issue when drag and dropping tabs from normal windows to blank windows
Fixed an issue on Windows systems with a large number of fonts installed where parts of the UI (tabs, menus, and Settings) could display garbled characters or symbols instead of readable text.
features: Added <u>'Sync only pinned tabs in workspaces'</u> option to the 'Tab Management' settings so that only pinned tabs will be synced across windows in a workspace. This is useful for users who want to keep their pinned tabs consistent across windows while allowing unpinned tabs to be different in each window.
Updated to Firefox 147.0.3

fixes: Zen will now restore unpinned tabs after a crash, even if the 'Restore previous session' setting is disabled.
Fixed syncing bookmarks with your Mozilla account not working correctly.
Other quality of life improvements and bug fixes.
features: Zen will now follow the XDG Base Directory Specification for storing its configuration and data files. This means that on Linux, configuration files will be stored in `~/.config/zen`. Note that compatibility with the old configuration directory (`~/.zen`) will be enabled if the directory exists.
Dragging a tab to the center of the window to create a split will now give the option to split on top or below.
When typing directly an url or domain, a second search result will appear with the option to search for the url or domain on your selected search engine.
Added a '--blank-window' command line argument to open a blank window without pinned tabs, spaces, etc.

fixes: Fixed accessibility issues with the workspace switcher and other buttons
Other session restore fixes and improvements

fixes.description: Fixed back / forward buttons changing the page's history instead of switching spaces

fixes: Fixed drag and dropping tabs from multiple windows with different spaces acting weirdly
Other minor bug fixes and improvements
Stability and performance improvements related to window sync and session restore.
features: Updated to Firefox 147.0.4
Appimage .desktop file now includes 'X-AppImage-Version' metadata for better integration with application launchers and system tools.
Linux desktop files will now include an option to open a new blank window from the taskbar

fixes: Stability and performance improvements related to window sync and session restore.
features: Improved greatly the performance for Linux users by removing bottom window rounded corners, which will be added once the core issue has been resolved upstream. To enable them back, turn 'widget.gtk.rounded-bottom-corners.enabled' to true in about:config.
Added more automatic recovery options when updating or restarting zen, to prevent tab loss.
Fixed some tabs becoming 'New Tabs' after focusing them from different windows

extra:
This update includes a new feature that allows you to automatically fill your folders with opened GitHub issues, pull requests or RSS feeds. To add a live folder, click the + button in the sidebar and select 'Live Folder'.

Let us know what other live folder types you would like to see in the future!

features: Updated to Firefox 148.0
Added live folders. Automatically fill your folders with opened GitHub issues, pull requests or RSS feeds. To add a live folder, click the + button in the sidebar and select 'Live Folder'.
Dragging a tab on top of another tab for one second will now allow the option to split those tabs.
MacOS users now get to use native popover UI, making the experience more consistent with the rest of the operating system.
Improved the icon picker for folders, tabs, etc. It now let you select icons without closing the picker.
Pressing the "Un-split" button while holding shift will not focus the un-split tab, allowing you to stay in the current split view.
changes: Bluring the window will no longer close the urlbar if its open.
Emojis at the space switcher will now be larger and more visible.
themeChanges: Removed the `-zen-window-transform-origin` CSS attribute as it is not needed anymore

fixes: Fixed certain popups on MacOS appearing with no background color, making them invisible.
Fixed Github Pull Request live folders not fetching the pull request data correctly.
Other minor bug fixes and improvements.
changes: Middle clicking on the sidebar will now simply open a new tab instead of searching the content stored inside the clipboard. This is to prevent accidental middle clicks from opening sensitive information. Middle clicking on the new tab button will still search the clipboard content.

fixes.description: Fixed some RSS live folders not working with certain feeds.
Improved performance for spaces, specially when switching between them.

fixes: Other minor bug fixes and improvements.
changes: Clicking on 'reset pinned tab' will now also select the pinned tab if it is not currently selected.
features: Updated to Firefox 148.0.2

fixes: Split views will now hide when toggling fullscreen mode.
Other minor bug fixes and improvements.

Fixed opening a new window making all tabs appear as 'New Tab' until they are selected.

features: Holding ctrl/cmd while hovering 'Reset pinned tab' will now duplicate that tab in the background
Added 'Unload all spaces except current' context menu item to the space switcher

fixes.description: Fixed background grain not showing properly
Fixed not being able to switch spaces with scroll actions
Fixed closing blank windows when asking for confirmation

fixes: Increased robustness of HTTP/3 upload performance for unstable network conditions.
Other minor bug fixes and improvements.
changes: Live folders will now perform a refresh when waking up the computer to make sure the content is up to date.
On Linux, Zen will now default to the XDG portal file picker if available, rather than the GTK3 one, which is usually better integrated with the user's desktop environment, and more powerful.
On Windows, Zen will use the modern Windows.Devices.Geolocation API for geolocation instead of Windows 7 location API.
features: Updated to Firefox 149.0
Optimized the performance glance and its animations, making it more responsive and smoother than before.
Added a 'Un-split tabs' context menu item when right-clicking on a tab inside a split view to quickly un-split it.
Many PDF files will now load significantly faster thanks to hardware acceleration.

Zen now automatically blocks notifications and permanently revokes permissions for any website flagged as malicious by SafeBrowsing. This prevents unsafe sites from sending background notifications to users, commonly used for ads, spam or phishing.
The WebRender layer compositor is now enabled on Windows, reducing power usage during full-screen video playback and improving WebGL/WebGPU performance.

extra: This release includes a major new feature called Boosts! Boosts allow you to customize the look and feel of any website to your liking. To start boosting, click the site's control icon in the urlbar and click the new 'Boost' button.

features: Updated to Firefox 151.0 and 151.0.1
Boosts are now in Zen! This allows you to tint colors, customize fonts and styles, zap elements and enable automatic dark mode on any website!
Overflowing web extensions will now appear below the urlbar instead of being added back into the site control panel. This only happens in single-sidebar mode.

Zen now strengthens protection against fingerprinting in Standard Enhanced Tracking Protection, making it harder for websites to track you across sites by limiting the amount of information revealed about your device and browser. This reduces the number of users uniquely identifiable by common fingerprinting techniques by an average of ~14%, and by ~49% on macOS.
You can now merge multiple PDFs directly in Zen PDF. Combine separate PDF files into a single document without ever leaving Zen or relying on third-party tools.

You can now filter draft GitHub pull requests in live folders.

Compact mode now tracks your mouse even after it leaves the window, the sidebar stays open while your cursor lingers near the window's edge and only tucks away once you move further out. This only changed for Windows and MacOS, Linux is still the same as before.

You can now move the window by dragging empty space in the top part of a webpage, with native snapping and tiling, just like dragging the titlebar. Links, buttons, and other interactive elements still work as usual.
You can now have multiple media controls in the sidebar, allowing you to control multiple media sources at once.

changes: Improved performance on all systems and benchmarks by using a different memory allocator
Video seeking is now significantly faster on all operating systems, making it quicker to jump to a point in a video.
Enabled webrender compositor on Linux, improving performance and reducing power usage on Linux systems that support it.
Text selected in a PDF is now highlighted the same way as text on a web page, and the highlight color follows operating system settings such as high-contrast mode.
features: Update Firefox version to 154.0
Local Zen profile backups are now available on macOS in addition to Windows and Linux, and backups can be restored across all three platforms.
Sites can now be exempted from having their cookies and site data cleared on shutdown without also being exempted from tracking protection and other cookie restrictions.
The full-page Translations feature now translates <iframe> content.
The full-page Translations feature now runs language identification on all page loads, resulting in an improved experience for offering translations to users.
Performing a hard reload on a page (holding Shift while clicking the Refresh button) now also clears and updates its cached favicons.

extra: This release includes a major new feature to sync your Spaces across devices using your Mozilla account! Please note that the first time this feature is enabled, it will merge both your local and cloud Spaces.
fixes: Fixed live folders for GitHub issues not working with the new GitHub UI

features: Updated to Firefox 155.0 and 155.0.1
By using your Mozilla account, you can now sync your Spaces, Folders, Tabs, and much more between devices! This can be enabled in Settings > Sync > Sync your Spaces across devices.
The chrome UI now has a better look and feel, implementing squircles and other design elements to make it more visually appealing.
A new on-boarding experience has been added to help new users get started with the browser and its features.
Creating a new Space is now faster and requires less animation wait time, making the process more efficient.
Containers can now be reordered in Settings, and the new order is used wherever containers are listed.
changes: Font size has been increased for the sidebar text, making it easier to read and navigate through tabs and spaces.
Zen now uses firefox-portal-detection.com instead of detectportal.firefox.com to detect captive portals and check network connectivity, so network allowlists referencing the old domain need updating.
PDFs smaller than the paper size can now be enlarged to fill the sheet when printing, by setting the scale above 100%.

fixes: Noticeably improved performance and battery usage while scrolling, and playing videos.
Other bug fixes and improvements.
features: You now have the option to sync normal tabs across devices along with your Spaces, Folders, and other data. This can be enabled in Settings > Sync > Sync your Spaces across devices.
You can now share Spaces, folders and split views to other Zen users and non-Zen users via a shareable link. This can be found in the context menu of a Space, folder or split view.
The on-boarding experience will now ask if you want to enable ad blocking, which will install uBlock Origin for enhanced privacy and security.

fixes: Fixed high-sample-rate FLAC audio in MP4 failing to play on certain video sites.
Fixed subtitles not appearing in the Picture-in-Picture window when they are turned on in the video player after the window has already opened.
Fixed the find bar becoming permanently unavailable in a tab after reversing the panes in Split View.
Fixed some sites failing to load when DNS over HTTPS is enabled and the site does not support HTTPS.

Added the following actions to the command bar: 'Expand current view', 'New space', 'Reopen closed tab', 'Duplicate tab', 'Reset pinned tab'.
changes: Zen's built-in PDF viewer now starts up to 45% faster.

On Windows devices with ARM64 processors, WebRTC video calls may now use hardware H264 decoding instead of falling back to software.
Live Folders will now ignore archived issues and pull requests.
Improved the look and feel of drag-and-drop interactions for tabs. Specially on MacOS, where the drag-and-drop behavior is now done natively.

You can now right-click the media tab in the Library to disable it.

fixes: Fixed various animation, urlbar and UI performance issues.

fixes.description: Fixed Library media tab requesting onedrive to download all files from cloud.
Fixed unwanted label next to the search icon in urlbar.
Fixed Avahi access so CUPS printers are listed in flatpak sandbox.
Fixed various memory leak issues.

fixes: Fixed a crash that could occur while Zen loaded website icons (favicons).

Fixed menus such as List all tabs, Settings, etc being hard to read with a Windows High Contrast theme. Menu background and text colors now follow the Background and Text colors chosen for a custom contrast theme in Windows Settings.
Other bug fixes and improvements.
changes: Space routing regex will now match URLs as case-insensitive.
Library's widget hover list will now only display recently downloaded files.
Zen no longer rounds scroll positions to whole screen pixels. Scrolling is now smoother and more precise, especially on high-resolution displays or when a page is zoomed.
features: Updated Firefox to 158.0
Added a `--space <id|name>` option to the command line interface.
Library will now show a 'Open in Folder' option and download speed when hovering over the toolbar icon.
Zen now creates more accessible PDFs when saving a page as PDF, and when printing on Linux and macOS. This also fixes a variety of PDF rendering issues, such as missing math symbols.

fixes: Mozilla blocked compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates via OneCRL on October 17th. The blocks were distributed to clients via Remote Settings the same day. This update contains the updated OneCRL block list, ensuring clients will block the compromised certificates even if RemoteSettings is disabled by policy or otherwise unavailable in the user's network environment. (Learn More)

fixes.description: Fixed the sidebar hiding when the mouse is still over it.
Fixed devtools not appearing on glance tabs.
Boosts zap bar will now push the web contents up when activated.
Fixed sidebar scroll being reset when entering fullscreen.
Fixed multiple windows launching on startup on Linux and Windows.

fixes: Fixed a crash on Windows when printing or saving a page as PDF while a screen reader or other assistive technology was running.
Fixed an issue where Zen was opening windows on the wrong monitor in multi-monitor setups on Linux.
Fixed multiple media bars appearing when 2 or more tabs are using WebRTC.
Fixed an issue where files dragged into Firefox from other applications were not dropped onto the page on macOS.
External links will now be routed through the Space Routing feature on startup
More bug fixes and improvements.
features: Updated to Firefox 158.0.1
Boosts now have a 'focus' feature, allowing you to concentrate on a specific part of the website.
Windows builds now run with CSIR PGO, improving performance and startup times. All other platforms also have performance improvements.

fixes.description: Fixed an issue where expanded glance tabs would not appear on the right Space.

fixes: Fixed the file upload dialog opening in the last folder a file was saved to, such as Downloads, instead of the folder last used for uploads.
Fixed memory usage growing rapidly when sites such as the Zoom web app were left open in a minimized window.
Fixed some videos displaying incorrectly on Windows when NVIDIA RTX Video HDR is enabled.
Fixed bookmarks not being imported from Google Chrome profiles that are signed in to a Google account.
Fixed the Replace button in Apple Writing Tools on macOS inserting the clipboard contents instead of the rewritten text on some sites.
Fixed long drop-down lists on web pages sometimes showing blank space in place of the last options until the list was scrolled.
Fixed some sites, such as Slack, failing to load instead of falling back to HTTP/2 when the site rejected an HTTP/3 request.
Fixed Zen using excessive memory on Linux with AMD graphics when viewing map or place results on sites such as ChatGPT.
Fixed quick gamepad button presses sometimes being missed in web games on macOS.
Fixed tabs sometimes detaching into a new window when clicked on Linux with Wayland.
Fixed menus and panels fading in on Windows and Linux when animation effects are turned off in the operating system.
More bug fixes and improvements.
changes: Zen's keyboard shortcuts have been improved and moved to about:keyboard.
Space Routing settings have been moved to the Library
On the site center, the reader mode button has been moved next to the 'Secure' button and shown only if available.
Web addresses written in the Javanese, Balinese, Canadian Aboriginal Syllabics, and N'Ko scripts are now displayed in their own script instead of as encoded "xn--" text.
features: Updated to Firefox 159.0
You can now import Spaces and Profiles from Arc and Dia.
Boosts gets a nice upgrade! They can now be shared with others and they get an overall quality improvement.
Holding 'ctrl' (or 'cmd' on macOS) while hovering over the new tab button will now give the option to 'Paste & Search'.
You can now remove/add tabs from the library.
An indicator will now show when a tab is not visible.

fixes: Fixed a command prompt window briefly appearing on Windows when Zen restarts to apply an update.
Fixed passkey sign-in failing on websites that share passkeys across related sites, such as Facebook and Instagram.
Fixed crashes on Windows that could occur with some antivirus or other security software installed, in some cases also leaving WebGL disabled.
Fixed red and blue colors appearing swapped on some websites that use WebGL on Linux, including video call background effects.
More bug fixes and improvements.
changes: On macOS, icons on the UI will now start using SF Symbols.
The 'About Zen' window has been redesigned.
'My Review Request' option for Pull Requests live folder now searches for 'user-review-requested:@me' instead of 'review-requested:@me'
features: Updated to Firefox 159.0.1
New grain options have been added to the theme picker. You can cycle through different grain effects by clicking on the circle inside the dial.

fixes: Improved performance for boosts color tinting.
Fixed the first character typed into the address bar or search bar sometimes being lost when typing quickly right after clicking into it.
Fixed Zen freezing for several seconds when signing in to intranet sites that use NTLM or Kerberos (Negotiate) authentication.
Fixed double-tapping or long-pressing a word to select it, and tapping to place the cursor, not working near the cursor in text fields.
Fixed links opened in the background from other apps on macOS, such as RSS readers, bringing Zen to the foreground.
Fixed downloaded files on macOS sometimes opening in the wrong application instead of the default one set in Finder.
Fixed simultaneous downloads on macOS never finishing when Zen is set to ask where to save files. Only the first file showed a save dialog.
Restored meaningful filenames and the usual save workflow for PDFs opened in Preview from the macOS print dialog.
More bug fixes and improvements.
changes: The address bar context menu now shows "Paste and Search" instead of "Paste and Go" when the copied text is a search term rather than a web address.
features: Updated to Firefox 160.0
Added pause context menu button for the downloads section
The urlbar now has a bit of transparency for a more modern look.
The Picture-in-Picture player now has a playback speed setting, with options ranging from 0.25x to 2.0x speed. The setting appears only when the player window is medium-sized or larger.
Pages saved as PDF now make mathematical content (MathML) accessible to assistive technology such as screen readers.
Websites that repeatedly ask to handle email (mailto:) and other links can now be blocked with a new “Never allow” button, and blocked sites can be managed in Settings.
Zen now plays Matroska (MKV) files with FLAC, MP3, or PCM audio.
WebGL content on macOS is now rendered using Apple's Metal graphics API, which can improve performance on some sites.

fixes.description: Fixed boosts color tinting and controls not working.
Fixed closed browser and popup windows never being freed from memory, which made memory usage and pauses grow over time.
Switching spaces is now smooth when spaces use gradient themes, instead of being choppy.
Fixed tabs shown in a split view or behind a glance being unloaded when memory runs low.
Fixed Spaces Sync for spaces and pinned tabs assigned to the built-in containers (Personal, Work, Banking, Shopping) on profiles that don't have them. Missing containers are now created when needed.
Fixed the copy URL shortcut copying "about:blank" while a page is still loading.
Improved performance when opening new windows with mods installed.

fixes: Fixed thin lines in PDFs printing as thick black boxes on some printers on Windows.
Fixed PDFs, web page graphics, and WebGL content appearing blank or broken on Macs with AMD graphics, such as black cells in Google Sheets.
Fixed incorrect colors in WebGL and canvas content, such as games and Google Meet backgrounds, on some Linux systems using Wayland.
Fixed links on some sites, such as the Google Store, taking a very long time to load.
Fixed tabs crashing on some sites, most notably ChatGPT.
Fixed WebTransport connections being unable to send datagrams after a site sent many in quick succession.
Fixed trackpad and mouse swipes sometimes scrolling the page when a site had blocked scrolling.
More bug fixes and improvements.
changes: The zoom level button is now hidden in the single toolbar layout. A toast shows the current zoom level when you change it instead.
features: Updated to Firefox 160.0.1
The copy URL and copy URL as Markdown shortcuts now copy the URLs of all selected tabs when multiple tabs are selected.
